fixed.member: DamageNumbers, OverheadBars, Nameplate, SelectionRing, Telegraph, PathLine, PlacementGhost, InteractionPrompt, LootLabel, SpeechBubble
fixed.summary: In-world documents retain their semantic anchors and ground projections while expressing their boxes in HTML with CSS. Nameplate health, shield and cast layers stay inside their tracks; placement grids and reach previews are contained by their footprint. Optional labels and shape branches occupy no blank space. Speech and interaction text use explicit spacing, loot counts have a distinct numeric readout, and overhead health bars follow the style's health token. All existing parts and ids remain available to style packs.
